Package frc.robot.utils

Class GameState

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.utils.GameState
public class GameState extends Object
Hub active/inactive timing for the 2026 game, read live from the DriverStation.

Call update() once per loop; every getter then reads that same snapshot so they always agree within a loop. The schedule itself lives in HubSchedule.

Fail-open: if the FMS game data or alliance is missing/unparseable, or there is no usable teleop clock, the hub is reported active (never block a shot because of bad data) and isDataValid() is false so dashboards can show the timer is not trustworthy.
